Market today: Tech is still the driver, but the broad market's choppy. Watch for any signs of a broader market shift, as your concentrated book amplifies moves.

Your holdings: CRWD (19.65%), QQQ (-11.3%), SMH (-33.62%), SMCI (-46.88%), SNOW (-20%), PLTU (-30.87%), MSFU (-16.66%), MU (-74.64%), SOXL (-85.75%), SPAL (-55.71%), QQQI (-15.53%), SPY (-2.41%), METU (-23.15%). Most are SELL/TRIM status and showing losses, especially the leveraged ETFs. SOXL and MU are deep in the red.

Watch: The semiconductor sector (SMH, SOXL) and leveraged tech ETFs (PLTU, MSFU, MU, SPAL) are under severe pressure. Monitor their ability to bounce or if they continue to break down.

Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are bleeding. Focus on managing risk and protecting capital in these volatile names.
plays: Consider trimming SMH if it breaks below its current price, given the deep loss and SELL status.
Evaluate exiting leveraged ETFs like SOXL and MU if they show no immediate signs of reversal, to cut further losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
